name: estimation-drill
title: Back-of-envelope drill
description: Guided numeric estimation with the listener doing the arithmetic first.
authoring_brief: Round aggressively and say so. Every number spoken in words. Pause for the listener to compute before revealing. Always sanity-check the result against a second route.

sections.title: The question
sections.brief: State the estimation target and the assumptions you'll allow.

sections.title: Your turn
sections.brief: Explicit pause for the listener to work it.

sections.title: Working it
sections.brief: Step by step, rounding out loud.

sections.title: Sanity check
sections.brief: A second derivation that should land in the same order of magnitude.
